name: context-band
description: One line above the prompt: context window fill, plan rate-limit windows, per-model weekly windows and other session figures, each one a toggle in /config

model.title: Model name
model.description: The model the session runs on, as /model shows it

folder.title: Working folder
folder.description: The name of the session's working directory

branch.title: Git branch
branch.description: The branch checked out in the working directory, when it is inside a git repository

context.title: Context window fill
context.description: How full the context window is, as a percentage

tokens.title: Context tokens
tokens.description: Tokens used over the window size beside the context percentage, like 54k/200k

resets.title: Reset countdowns
resets.description: Time until each rate-limit window resets, like (2hr 15m), after its percentage

models.title: Per-model windows
models.description: One entry per model-scoped weekly window the account has, like Fable 36%

cost.title: Session cost
cost.description: What the session has cost so far in US dollars, as /cost totals it

turns.title: Turn count
turns.description: How many prompts have been sent this session

duration.title: Session duration
duration.description: Time since the session started, refreshed every minute

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: The current time as HH:MM, refreshed every minute
